permissionScope.permittedPurpose: Runtime-only, native-primary set identification in the StackrTCG app, with English wording displayed only as a labelled non-authoritative supplement.
permissionScope.territory: Worldwide app delivery where StackrTCG makes the relevant feature available.
permissionScope.term: For the duration of the represented permission, subject to immediate disablement on expiry, withdrawal, source mismatch, or a substantiated complaint.
permissionScope.transformationRights: NFKC and whitespace normalization for exact identity matching; display of the bound English editorial wording; no translation of card rules, attacks, flavour text, or artwork.
permissionScope.storageRights: Retain hash-bound source and generated runtime maps only; do not write the supplement into canonical catalogue rows.
permissionScope.deletionRequirements: Disable or remove the affected language, set, or source mapping promptly after expiry, withdrawal, mismatch, or a substantiated complaint while retaining the audit record.
permissionScope.attribution: Preserve source provenance and label the value English translation: without representing it as an official translation.
permissionScope.downstreamDeliveryRights: Display inside the StackrTCG app and its bounded API response only; no bulk export, resale, or corpus distribution.
